Interface Attackable

All Known Implementing Classes:
AoeUnit, Cat1, CatTower, Dog1, DogTower, FishCat, Hippo, KnightCat, Pig, SingleTargetUnit, Snake, Stickman, TofuCat, Tower, UFOCat, Unit
public interface Attackable
Defines the contract for any entity that can participate in combat — receiving damage, dealing damage to targets, and reporting its death state.
